notes.title: Hotfix 0.9.0-demo – Bug Fixes for the Demo
notes.content:
This version 0.9.0-demo had the goal to fix 2 issues:

1 - A bug allowing you to complete a quest even when you didn't have the required Items.
2 - High CPU usage.  

Unfortunately, it also introduced a new bug, which happened when you opened the Quest Button in the footer.  

To fix that, I released version 0.9.1-demo, so please make sure that you are not using the 0.9.0-demo.  

Sorry for the inconvenience.
